name: Olaparib Maintenance (BRCA-mutated Epithelial Ovarian/Fallopian Tube/Primary Peritoneal Cancer)
cyclesNote: continuous twice-daily dosing; up to 2 years post-primary maintenance unless disease progression or unacceptable toxicity (may continue beyond 2 years if not in CR); until progression or unacceptable toxicity in the post-recurrence maintenance setting

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.BRCA1_2: germline or somatic pathogenic/likely pathogenic (P/LP) variant required
biomarkers.note: Biomarker gated: single-agent olaparib maintenance requires a germline or somatic BRCA1/2 P/LP variant. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Ovarian OV-5, olaparib is a category 1 post-primary maintenance option for BRCA1/2-mutated disease; it is also listed for BRCA1/2 wild-type or unknown with HR deficiency, but FDA labeling restricts single-agent olaparib to germline or somatic BRCA-mutated disease. In the post-recurrence maintenance setting, PARP inhibitor maintenance is restricted to the BRCA1/2-mutated setting (OV-D footnote a) and requires no prior progression on a PARP inhibitor.

histology: epithelial ovarian carcinoma (high-grade serous, grade 2/3 endometrioid, or BRCA1/2-mutated clear cell carcinoma or carcinosarcoma per the maintenance-eligible population). Fallopian tube and primary peritoneal carcinoma are treated as ovarian carcinoma.
supportiveCare: monitor for cytopenias; olaparib can cause myelosuppression and carries a risk of myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia with prolonged exposure.
antiemetic support as needed for nausea per package insert.
monitoring: CBC: careful monitoring of blood counts is required (baseline and periodic; hold for prolonged cytopenia and evaluate for MDS/AML)
renal and hepatic function monitoring is recommended
blood pressure monitoring is recommended for olaparib (required for niraparib)

doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and consider dose reduction per package insert; if cytopenia is prolonged, evaluate for MDS/AML before resuming. Physician decides.

drugs.name: Olaparib
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy. Olaparib 300 mg PO twice daily, taken continuously (cycleLengthDays 1 represents continuous daily dosing). Refer to the package insert for renal or hepatic dose adjustments and for tablet-versus-capsule bioequivalence (the 300 mg dose is the tablet formulation).
